name: Sorcery Points
description: Sorcery points pay for Flexible Casting and your Metamagic options. You can never hold more than the maximum for your level.
A long rest refills them all.

name: Font of Magic
description: Bonus action: swap between spell slots and sorcery points.
Make a slot: spend points to create one slot of 5th level or lower. Cost: 1st level 2 points, 2nd level 3, 3rd level 5, 4th level 6, 5th level 7.
Burn a slot: expend one slot and gain sorcery points equal to its level.

name: Sorcerous Restoration
description: When you finish a short rest, you regain 4 expended sorcery points.
